unlisted_practices: Using an LLM to generate culturally contextualized virtual patient profiles for simulated administration of a validated psychometric adherence scale
Expert rating of LLM-generated profiles for credibility and cultural appropriateness

screen.reason: The study evaluates the feasibility and credibility of using ChatGPT-4 to generate simulated/virtual patient profiles with type 2 diabetes to assess medication adherence scales, without evaluating a specific deployment practice or guardrail.
